title: POTTED VEAL
instructions: The livers to be well larded. Put in stewpan with lard,  onion,  carrots,  pepper,  salt, a few aromatic herbs, a glass of white wine, let them simmer for three hours. Add a calf's foot, cut in half, and well boiled for several hours. Take out the bones of the calf's foot, put in a bowl to get cold. Will form a nice jelly to be eaten with salad.
